parties: Sampann Utpadan India Limited (Company) v. NSE (Regulator)
headline: NSE Imposes ₹4.2 Lakh Penalty on Sampann Utpadan India Limited
sum: NSE has imposed a regulatory penalty of ₹4,20,000 on Sampann Utpadan India Limited, which the company has formally intimated to the stock exchange as required under disclosure norms.
implication: Listed companies must promptly disclose all regulatory penalties to the exchange under LODR 2015 Regulation 30; the intimate filing is primary evidence of the penalty and its notification timeline.
detail: Sampann Utpadan India Limited, a listed entity on NSE, has received a penalty order from NSE. The company has complied with disclosure obligations by intimating the exchange of the penalty in accordance with stock exchange regulations. The precise ground for the penalty (compliance breach, reporting lapse, procedural violation, etc.) is not detailed in the available public disclosure but is likely documented in NSE's enforcement notice to the company.
